generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: an introduced, dandelion-like herb: a flat rosette of hairy, lobed leaves and wiry, branched stems with yellow heads. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 0.4 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: mid-green leaves; yellow heads.

appearance.organs.flower.note: The head's straps, the model's choice: its receptacle 0.45 of the open head's width, the straps reaching past the involucre as the flora's 10 to 15 mm florets do, each 0.9 as wide as its share of a ring, so they overlap.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

generator.program.note: The program the spec's authors chose to grow this form.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.note: FNA's account of the species (Bogler, volume 19), as search results quote copies of its text (the pages themselves were not read): involucres cylindric or bell-shaped, 10 to 25 mm tall and 10 to 20 mm across; phyllaries 20 to 30, unequal; florets 10 to 15 mm, past the phyllaries at flowering; pappus of whitish bristles in two rows, the inner plumose, the longest 10 to 12 mm.

sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values
sources.licence: project contribution under the repository's terms

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy from the step-6 catalogue, authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands. Calibration against measurements and photographs is milestone P4.
